hypotheses: OSI-027 (2 uM, 24 h) produces a reproducible histone perturbation in A375 cells, with the strongest measured effects on H3K27me0K36me2, H3K27ac1K36me2, and H3K27me1K36me1 marks.
Donors with high anchor similarity to the OSI-027 A375 histone profile are more likely to transfer a target-minus-A375 response that preserves the observed histone mark changes.

Etoposide, Resveratrol, Bortezomib, Carfilzomib, and flavopiridol are the most promising donor candidates based on anchor similarity and/or known chromatin-related pharmacology, and their pharmacology descriptions should be retrieved to assess transfer suitability.
object.evidence_gap: No donor has a perfect match to the OSI-027 A375 histone response; the selected donors are based on anchor similarity and pharmacological plausibility, but their actual target-minus-A375 histone responses are not yet available and must be retrieved to confirm transferability.
